front.title: Composite Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm (ML-DSA) for Use in X.509 Public Key Infrastructure
front.workgroup: Limited Additional Mechanisms for PKIX and SMIME

abstract.t: This document defines a PQ/T hybrid scheme with concrete instantiations that combine the US NIST Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm (ML-DSA) with traditional algorithms RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5, RSASSA-PSS, ECDSA, Ed25519, and Ed448. These combinations are tailored to meet regulatory guidelines in certain regions. Composite ML-DSA is applicable in applications that use X.509 or PKIX data structures that accept ML-DSA, but where the operator wants extra protection against breaks or catastrophic bugs in ML-DSA and where the level of security provided by Existential Unforgeability under Chosen Message Attack (EUF-CMA) is acceptable.
